lead_deck: 23rd Lycian Waterway Walk and Patara Nomad Migration event took place in Kaş
lead_body: The 23rd Lycian Waterway Walk and Patara Nomad Migration event was held in Kaş. The event highlighted the beauty of the Lycian Waterway and the importance of the Patara Nomad Migration. The revitalisation of the tourism season in the Kalkan and Kaş region was also discussed at the event.
